label: Invariant explanans: one choice cell containing every compared history
definition: InvariantExplanans F m a: every two histories through m are related by a's choice relation, so level a has a single cell. Example: a source's necessary nature, propensity, standing will or generative finality, the same in every compared history. Non-example: an exercise (adoption, actualization) that differs between histories with different outcomes.
note: Stipulative. The STIT surrogate for an explanans that does not vary across the compared scope; it does not assert that any real source is invariant. See docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md §59.
